input.quote: The relationship of the Parties is that of independent contractors, and nothing herein is intended, nor should be construed, to create a partnership, agency, joint venture or employment relationship.
input.rationale: No non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant exists in the agreement. Searches for "solicit", "non-solicitation", "hire", "employ or engage", "induce", "recruit", "poach", "personnel" and "directly or indirectly" return no restrictive hiring covenant; the only employment-adjacent text is the independent contractor/no-agency clause cited (p0066), the mutual indemnities (p0051/p0052) and confidentiality handling by employees (p0061), none of which restricts either party from hiring. Because our preferred NOSOLICIT position is that no non-solicit bind the Customer, this absence satisfies the preferred position and no redline or counterparty comment is required. The deterministic sub-checks on duration and general-solicitation carve-out are inapplicable, as there is no covenant to measure. Internal note only (not to be raised with Kubient): if a non-solicit is later proposed, we would require it be mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the services, capped at 12 months from the end of their involvement, with carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches, and no "no-hire".
